decisions.reason: The accepted change enables ETH and USDC wallet-payment selection; it does not alter the separate Transak fiat-mint flow or its deferred lifecycle.
ETH was already the candidate's supported wallet payment asset. The source adds customer-facing selection at checkout but does not change the ETH mint flow itself.
Choosing between ETH and USDC does not change the existence, optionality, placement, or amounts of the mint gratuity.
USDC was already supported by the candidate. Adding an ETH-or-USDC selection control does not change the required behavior of the USDC mint path.
The wallet-payment option decision does not change the mint price or allocation of mint revenue.
The payment-selection change does not alter the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The source approves checkout behavior but does not instruct that the approved FAQ copy or its listed topics be revised to disclose ETH and USDC selection.
Primary-mint wallet payment selection does not affect secondary-sale royalty amount, enforcement, disclosure, or marketplace controls.
Selecting ETH or USDC does not change the commission allocation applied when a referral is missing or invalid.
The payment-option selector does not change email magic-link authentication or fiat-buyer dashboard access.
Enabling ETH and USDC choices does not modify SIWE authentication, its protected flows, or Transak-created-wallet dashboard access.
The source approves checkout payment selection but does not revise the About-page content or resolve its prize-payout ambiguity.
